answer: To enforce robust Sybil resistance, our framework constructs a cryptographic haven where autonomous agents must bind identity generation to recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments and verifiable delay primitives. This sequence forces attackers to deposit an ivory standard of staking collateral that faces severe slashing penalties, guaranteeing negative expected utility and a secure Nash equilibrium. By anchoring these proofs, the network's foundational timber resists identity cloning through information-theoretic unforgeability.
